title: Default identity lacks Write for non-operator callers
objective: AgentIdentity::default() (models.rs:139) returns anonymous with empty capabilities. Server default_agent() grants Read+Write so the HTTP API is fine; this only affects programmatic PromptHub::new() callers. Documented workaround: AgentIdentity::local_operator(). Blocked: design decision needed on whether default should carry Write.
acceptance_criteria: a decision is recorded on default identity capabilities (and applied or explicitly deferred)
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: Owner decision (2026-06-13 via /verify follow-up): the default identity should carry Read+Write (mirroring the server's default_agent), a deliberate RBAC posture change. Implemented: AgentIdentity::default() now sets capabilities = vec![Read, Write] (was empty) with an updated doc comment explaining the posture and pointing unprivileged/denial callers at an explicit empty-capabilities identity (or local_operator for Admin). Blast-radius swept so denial coverage survives: test_get_rbac.rs anonymous() and defaults.rs unauthorized() now build an explicit empty-caps identity instead of default(); the two test_agent_identity_default tests (tests/test_models.rs + src/models.rs lib test) updated to assert Read+Write present, Admin absent. Gates: 876 lib tests pass; test_models 33, test_get_rbac 6, test_security 9, test_hub 18; workspace build+clippy -D warnings (--all-features AND default); fmt; rustdoc -D warnings. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0040-default-identity.
